scientific_integrity: Original Ji--Ma map, adjacency and stationary cell masses and general countable Markov entropy theory are credited; algebraic graph invariant and quantitative entropy gap evaluated here. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Covers only Ji--Ma auxiliary map T_lambda and its countable-state symbolic coding; invariant probability entropy only for lambda in (0,1/2). No assertion about original bimodal map f_lambda, which is not semiconjugate to this auxiliary map.
title: Exact golden-ratio symbolic entropy and a uniform metric-entropy gap in an auxiliary Fibonacci-bimodal map
